entries.name: Check data balance
entries.description: Check your remaining Airtel Nigeria data balance; *323# also shows your data expiry date. Confirmed on the official Airtel Nigeria FAQ page.
instructions: Dial *323#.
Your data balance (and expiry date) is displayed.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: View data bundles
entries.description: View all data bundles available on the Airtel Nigeria network. Confirmed on the official Airtel Nigeria FAQ page.
instructions: Dial *312#.
Follow the menu to view and buy a data bundle.
entries.costNote: Bundle prices vary by plan. Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Borrow airtime
entries.description: Borrow airtime from Airtel Nigeria when you run out, repaid on your next recharge. Confirmed on the official Airtel Nigeria FAQ page.
instructions: Dial *303#.
Follow the menu options to select your preferred loan amount.
entries.costNote: Service fees apply and are shown during the session.
entries.securityWarning: This creates a debt on your line repaid from your next recharge.

entries.name: Transfer airtime
entries.description: Transfer airtime to another Airtel Nigeria number. Confirmed on the official Airtel Nigeria FAQ page.
instructions: Dial *321#.
Follow the menu to transfer airtime to another Airtel number.
entries.networkScope: Airtel Nigeria to Airtel Nigeria only
entries.costNote: Transfer limits and fees are set by Airtel.
entries.securityWarning: Double-check the recipient number before confirming.

entries.name: Recharge airtime or data from your bank
entries.description: Buy Airtel Nigeria airtime or data directly from a linked bank account or debit card. Confirmed on the official Airtel dial-444 page.
instructions: Dial *444# (or *444*AMOUNT# for quick recharge).
Select the service you want: recharge for self or buy data bundles.
Choose payment through your bank or a debit card.
entries.networkScope: Airtel Nigeria lines linked to a bank account or with a debit card
entries.costNote: Airtel states *444# is free to use; bundle and airtime prices still apply.

entries.name: Check my tariff plan
entries.description: See which Airtel Nigeria tariff plan your line is on. Confirmed on the official Airtel Nigeria FAQ page.
instructions: Dial *121#.
Select 'Manage my account'.
Select 'My tariff plan'.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Check MTN balance
entries.description: Check your MTN Nigeria airtime and data balance from the account menu. Widely published code; kept corroborated pending an operator-page check.
instructions: Dial *556#.
Your balance is shown on screen.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Check my MTN number

instructions: Dial *123#.

entries.name: Buy MTN data bundles
entries.description: Buy an MTN Nigeria data bundle from the data menu. Confirmed on the official MTN Nigeria data help page alongside *904#.
instructions: Choose a bundle and confirm the purchase.
entries.costNote: Bundle prices vary by plan. Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: MTN MoMo menu (Nigeria)

entries.costNote: Transaction fees apply per MoMo tariff.
entries.securityWarning: This starts financial transactions. Never share your PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

entries.name: NIN services (retrieve/link)
entries.description: Retrieve your National Identification Number or use NIMC self-service options. Widely published codes; kept corroborated because the NIMC page required JavaScript at last check.
instructions: Dial *346# to retrieve your NIN on the registered line.
Follow NIMC guidance (e.g. *996# options) to link or manage NIN services.
entries.networkScope: Any Nigerian mobile line; retrieval works on the NIN-registered line
entries.costNote: NIMC notes a small service fee may apply for NIN retrieval.
entries.securityWarning: Your NIN is sensitive identity data; only use official NIMC flows.

notice: Each entry records the source page used for the last check. Corroborated codes are widely published but still awaiting an operator-page check; re-check with the operator if a code no longer matches. USSD menus can change by SIM, plan, device, or date.
